## Overview

A Monte Carlo simulation modeling Cs-137 gamma rays passing through a tungsten slit collimator onto a CdZnTe (CZT) semiconductor detector, built with [OpenGATE 10](https://opengate-python.readthedocs.io/) (GEANT4).

**Source code:** [github.com/MaxTeicheiraUCSC/gate_sim](https://github.com/MaxTeicheiraUCSC/gate_sim)

## Geometry

- **Source:** Cs-137 point source
- **Collimator:** 50 mm tungsten with 0.2 mm slit
- **Detector:** 5 × 40 × 40 mm CZT semiconductor

## Features

- **Physics modeling** -- energy deposits, per-event summation, energy resolution blurring (2% FWHM), and phase space recording
- **Distributed execution** -- built for SLURM cluster environments with parallel job submission
- **Real-time monitoring** -- Slack integration for progress reporting
- **Analysis pipeline** -- post-processing tools for merging results, energy spectrum analysis, hit mapping, and 3D geometry visualization

## Outputs

The simulation produces ROOT files containing detector hits, summed energies, blurred spectra, and phase space data, along with analysis visualizations including energy histograms, hit maps, and 3D trajectory plots.
